title: Gradient Descent: The Engine of Deep Learning

timeline.title: Gradient Descent
narration: Welcome to this short lecture on gradient descent.
Gradient descent is the workhorse algorithm behind modern deep learning.

timeline.title: The Core Idea
narration: The idea is simple. We compute the gradient of the loss with respect to the parameters, and then we take a small step in the opposite direction.
We repeat this process until the loss stops improving.

timeline.title: The Learning Rate
narration: The learning rate controls how big each step is.
If the learning rate is too large, training can diverge. If it is too small, training becomes very slow.

timeline.title: In Practice
narration: In practice we rarely use the exact gradient. Stochastic gradients trade exactness for speed.
Momentum and adaptive methods smooth the trajectory, and learning rate schedules start large and decay over time.

timeline.title: Next Steps
narration: In the next lecture, we will derive the gradient for a linear model, and implement the update rule in code.
We will also visualize the loss surface and the optimization path. Thanks for watching.
